implementation.timing_clock: time.perf_counter_ns around ranked-list production only; shared co-change candidate-history expansion is measured once per seed and charged in full to each co-change model

protocol.candidate_universe: files existing immediately before the query commit, excluding seed
protocol.delete_readd_treatment: a deleted path later added receives a new logical identity and no stale history
protocol.ground_truth: pre-commit touched logical files; additions excluded; deletions included
protocol.history_order: first-parent graph order, oldest to newest within replay window
protocol.pair_representation_note: exact representation optimization only; no commit excluded or downweighted
protocol.path_score: descending tuple(shared directory-prefix component depth, case-sensitive full-basename SequenceMatcher ratio); raw-path tie
protocol.precision_denominator: fixed K; short rankings are padded with misses
protocol.random_draw: uniform without replacement from the pre-commit candidate universe
protocol.rename_detection: git --find-renames=50%; similarity detection may lazily fetch blobs but models do not inspect contents
protocol.rename_treatment: emitted R is one stable identity, old path at query then migrated to new path
